authority_limits: Static review is not a test-run receipt or fresh capacity measurement.
Historical and new native attempts, actual resource claims and completion outcomes are not inspected or inferred.
No original corpus, capture, reference, teacher, checkpoint or private source payload bodies read.

findings.evidence: MAX_STORAGE_BYTES remains 160_000_000_000. Refusal remains charged > MAX_STORAGE_BYTES or free < outstanding + additional; equality passes. Observed apparent bytes plus full outstanding nonreleased reservations plus additional request remain unchanged.

AST parity preserves lock/read/account/write ordering, native scheduler lane/policy/acquisition, reservation status transitions, retained failed claims, child attachment, monitoring, durability and explicit release. Refusal still precedes new reservation insertion/write/native acquisition. No new persistent pre-admission artifact, ledger write, capacity bypass, census, cleanup or release path is introduced; existing lock behavior remains unchanged.

DaemonResourceError remains a RuntimeError subclass without a new constructor. Refusal type, message and args remain compatible. Launcher catches that type around one owner.open call, emits diagnostic if eligible, then bare-raises the same exception. Other failures are not relabeled. Formatter catches ordinary formatting/write/flush exceptions so they do not mask original admission refusal.

Snapshot uses only existing local result scalar fields, fixed schema/scope, two flags and two nonnegative deficits; excludes inventory, root paths, reservation IDs, process identities, claims and authority tokens. Capture and property access deepcopy the snapshot. No additional resource observation occurs.

Formatter accepts exact field set, fixed message/schema/scope, nonnegative integers strictly below 2**63 excluding booleans, exact bool flags and consistent charged/deficit arithmetic. JSON is a single line of at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Diagnostic is descriptive and confers no admission or policy authority.

Stdlib test module extracts actual exception/_account/formatter/open-handler ASTs. All inventory, disk, owner calls and stderr are invented or in memory. Cases cover unchanged cap, separate/combined deficits, both equality boundaries, released-row exclusion, detached private-free snapshot, normal-error absence, exact bounded JSON, malformed field/scalar refusal, distinct error message, unavailable stderr and identical exception re-raise once.

method.ast_parity: Parse only; no reviewed source compilation or execution. Removing new exception property and restoring original capacity-refusal body gives identical resource-module AST. Removing new formatter and flattening the single owner.open handler gives identical launcher AST.
method.bounded_reads: Only three finalized source/test files and their first two HEAD Git baselines.
method.independent_subreview: /root/conditions_rank_counter_f19/v2_dependency_inventory separately read and hashed all three finalized files and reviewed test isolation/coverage; no runtime.

nonblocking_test_coverage_limits: No dedicated invalid schema/scope test, negative numeric test, or stderr.flush failure test; corresponding guards are present.
scope: Static source and AST comparison only; no product imports, tests, native resource admission, ledger or fleet reads.
